statement: A k-projective symmetric-group lattice whose canonical Schur-induced module is k-perfect has K0(k)-linear Young permutation generation; the lift is always k-finitely-presented
depends_on: Efimov2015 Proposition3.16; Krause2021 Theorem8.4.11; finite corner and admissible Euler transfer
notes: Sufficient lemma only, not claimed as an intrinsic necessary-and-sufficient all-ring criterion

statement: For every nonzero commutative regular-coherent ring polynomial induction is an isomorphism exactly when characteristic is zero and Z to K0(k) is an isomorphism
notes: All regular-coherent rings, with no Noetherian or dimension hypothesis; does not close remaining arbitrary-ring C1

statement: For every valuation domain of arbitrary rank and value group polynomial induction is an isomorphism exactly in characteristic zero
notes: Includes nondiscrete mixed-characteristic valuation domains; domain convention explicit

statement: For a coherent characteristic-zero ring with K0=Z local regular coherence only at primes over n! suffices for degree-n polynomial induction; all positive residue primes suffice in every degree
depends_on: C:Schur-perfect-generation; coherent syzygies and quasi-compact local-perfectness argument; averaging away n!
notes: Extends regular_modular_locus beyond Noetherian rings; characteristic-zero singular points allowed
